dedupe_keys.name: latvian kpfi building renovation projects financing and monitored performance

description: The Energy Efficiency Financing Dataset describes 445 Latvian building-renovation projects funded through eleven KPFI programme tenders. The Latvian Environmental Investment Fund collected applicant and building-stakeholder information, which the research collaborators organized into three Excel workbooks. They cover project dates, costs and grants, implemented activities, and energy and carbon figures before and after renovation. The article places the records within 2011–2020 and describes monitoring for five years after implementation. Mendeley provides free access under CC BY 4.0. Coverage includes participating public and private buildings, not the entire building stock. Planned reductions, reported outcomes and monthly operating conditions are distinct fields; differences do not by themselves establish causal retrofit savings. A reviewer-assessed use is supplying retrofit-cost assumptions and observed performance ranges to building-stock simulations. model-energyplus is a related building simulation resource, although no project was converted into an executable model. No workbook calculations were checked.
